verdict.note: PASS: public CLI recorded only canonical loopback URLs; the host gateway streamed current HTTP and WebSocket responses, rejected guessed keys before contact, reported a dead target, and reached an IPv6 loopback service.

PASS: real CLI posted the service after the dashboard loaded; Chromium auto-opened one same-origin tab, refreshed web revision 7 to 8, opened the file from plus, suppressed duplicates, reopened after close, and removed the web tab after retract.

Public Chromium requested the published same-origin iframe route with its browser Accept header. The iframe URL named the posted key, but its body was the dashboard shell rather than the Northstar service page because the host fallback intercepted text/html first.
Public Chromium opened the posted Northstar Studio service through the dashboard iframe; the live page rendered and Rotate focus changed its state.
